securityIncident.what: A redaction sed pattern matched past the token instead of over it, printing a live GitHub App installation token in plaintext in chat. That transcript was written to .rork/history/main/**, which is tracked in git, and was then pushed to GitHub in branch rork-agent-engineering-tools at commit e602dee1.
securityIncident.detectedBy: The secret_scan gate built in this same session, during this audit, before any further push.
securityIncident.tokenType: GitHub App installation token, 1 hour lifetime
remediation: Remote branch rork-agent-engineering-tools DELETED from ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform; deletion verified via git ls-remote returning empty.
Token is short-lived and Rork-rotated hourly; it expires on its own at 12:02:22Z.
securityIncident.ownerActionRecommended: Treat the token as compromised. It is Rork-managed and expires 12:02:22Z, but if you can force rotation of the installation credential, do it.
securityIncident.repeatOffence: This is the second time in this engagement that the agent printed a secret while running a command intended to redact secrets.
